findings.description: Inocencio Gonzales and Antonia Uraque had a daughter, Juana Gonzalo, born 19 July 1895 and baptised 21 July 1895 at Sacaca, Alonzo de Ibáñez, Potosí, Bolivia; the baptism indexes the parents as Inocencio Gonsalo and Antonia Araque.

target_person.name: Juana Gonzalo
